{{Current events|year=2025|month=04|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[2025 India–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***[[Indian Armed Forces|India]]n and [[Pakistan Armed Forces|Pakistan]]i military troops exchange [[Gunshot|gunfire]] across the [[Line of Control]] during an ongoing [[2025 India–Pakistan diplomatic crisis|diplomatic crisis]] caused by a [[2025 Pahalgam attack|terrorist attack]] in [[India]]-administered [[Kashmir]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2025/4/25/india-pakistan-tensions (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip famine]]
***The [[World Food Programme]] (WFP) claims that their entire food stock inside the [[Gaza Strip]] is empty due to the [[Israel]]i blockade of [[humanitarian aid]]. WFP aid kitchens are expected to run out of food in a few days, and thousands of [[Palestinians]] are expected to [[famine|die]] from [[starvation]]. The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs|Office for Humanitarian Affairs]] calls the situation "probably the worst" since the beginning of the war in October 2023. [https://www.dw.com/en/world-food-programme-warns-of-mass-starvation-in-gaza/a-72356829 (DW)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Lieutenant general]] [[Yaroslav Moskalik]], deputy head of the [[Main Operational Directorate of the General Staff of the Russian Armed Forces|Main Operations Directorate]] of the [[General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation|General Staff]] of the [[Russian Armed Forces]], is [[assassination|assassinated]] in a [[car bomb]]ing in [[Balashikha]], [[Moscow Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/04/25/europe/russian-military-officer-killed-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Death and funeral of Pope Francis]]
**Cardinals seal the coffin of [[Pope Francis]] in a private liturgical rite led by [[Camerlengo of the Holy Roman Church|Camerlengo]] [[Kevin Farrell]] at [[St. Peter's Basilica]] in [[Vatican City]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/25/europe/pope-francis-coffin-close-vatican-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**The [[Germany|German]] [[Federal Government of Germany|government]] cuts its [[Economic growth|economic growth forecast]] to zero, with the [[Deutsche Bundesbank]] estimating a future [[Recession|recession]]. [[Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action|Minister of Economic Affairs]] [[Robert Habeck]] accuses [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Liberation Day tariffs]] of being the primary reason for [[Germany]]'s continued [[Financial crisis|economic crisis]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-expects-zero-growth-in-2025-blames-trump-tariffs/a-72338707 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A man is killed and two women are wounded as an 80-year-old driver loses control over his car and plunges into a group of people celebrating the 80th anniversary of the [[Italian campaign (World War II)|liberation of Italy]] in [[Lanciano]], [[Province of Chieti]]. [https://www.chietitoday.it/cronaca/incidente-stradale/tragedia-lanciano-auto-piomba-corteo-25-aprile-morto-uomo-81-anni.html (''Chieti Today'')] [https://www.chicagotribune.com/2025/04/25/conductor-pierde-el-control-y-atropella-a-varios-en-italia-muere-1-persona/ (''Chicago Tribune'')]
*A [[Royal Thai Police]] [[Viking Air|Viking]] [[de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter|DHC-6 Twin Otter]] [[police aviation|aircraft]] crashes while conducting a test flight for [[parachuting]] training near [[Hua Hin Airport]] in [[Prachuap Khiri Khan]], [[Thailand]], killing all six people on board. [https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40049239 (''The Nation'')] [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-police-plane-crash-hua-hin-28d0337255c5b87d51f7e7727f57b125 (AP)]
*A [[Richter scale|M{{sub|w}}]] 6.3 [[earthquake]] strikes [[Esmeraldas, Ecuador|Esmeraldas]], [[Ecuador]], shutting down power, damaging 800 buildings and injuring 32 people. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/274464/6-3-ecuador-quake-hundreds-of-buildings-damaged-dozens-injured (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Former [[Brazil]]ian [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Fernando Collor de Mello]] is arrested following a [[corruption]] conviction by [[Supreme Federal Court]] justice [[Alexandre de Moraes]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-fernando-collor-former-president-corruption-prison-04c4c04d633c7a02aadd086e2fcaf734 (AP)]
*[[Wisconsin circuit courts|Wisconsin circuit court]] judge [[Hannah Dugan]] is arrested by [[United States]] [[Federal law enforcement in the United States|federal law enforcement]] on [[obstruction of justice|obstruction]] charges after allegedly helping an [[illegal immigration to the United States|undocumented immigrant]] evade arrest. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/25/fbi-arrest-judge-hannah-dugan-milwaukee.html (CNBC)]
